name: Love & Layups
source:
Step into Game of Love, TV’s hottest reality show, where basketball girlfriends fight for fame, friendship, and fortune. Alliances shift, drama explodes, and the cameras capture it all – but when your feelings for the team captain turn real, the ultimate question is: heart or spotlight?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Love_%26_Layups]Choices Wikia[/url]]
